memory.text: No hard-sell and no fake urgency (no 'only today', no countdowns).
Never invent prices or discounts. Only show prices the client gave us.
Warm, first person, a little Hinglish. Sounds like a friend, not a catalogue.
Say 'handloom' and 'weaver' with respect. Never 'cheap' or 'budget'.
Wedding-season posts did well last year, especially behind-the-loom clips.

evidence.quote: Wedding reel got 3x saves vs average

memory.text: End on a calm call to action card with the shop name, held for 2 seconds.
Clips named loom_* and drape_* are cleared for use. Model faces are not.
Avoid generic 'festive sale' framing. It felt off-brand last time.

brief_text: Make a 20 to 30 second vertical ad for the new handloom cotton collection, aimed at women planning for the wedding season. Lead with the craft (the loom, the weaver's hands), keep the voice warm and first person, and end on a quiet shop-name card. No prices, no urgency.
